column3: The attack, named enemy and order for coordinated reinforcements must survive together.
The tax order concerns payers shielding themselves under a powerful official. Unrelated illness or rank corrupts it.
One option conveys deafness, cheek heat, rib pain and inability to move the lower leg. 大腿 changes the affected site.
The threatened speaker compares the others with the knife and chopping board, and his own party with fish and meat.
The discovery of the Liao ruler's location explains the advance. Several outputs lose the causal link.
The princess requests a plaque. 不惟 introduces an additional reason instead of expressing reluctance.
The fugitive and his killer must remain distinct and named.
The court official resists the proposal and Cai Jing's words have no effect.
韩哲 was summoned and executed although innocent. Most of the source can survive even when the name disappears.
The emperor asks which three deeds surpass others. One output asks whether there is anything to do.
The emperor asks Zhang Guo to identify the cyclical year. 果然 and 为什么 both change the question.
The date, appointment and title survive in three choices. A repeated comma is a minor surface error.
The list of poetic genres and the author's spontaneous composition disappear in most alternatives.
The isolated words 主命 require ritual context. Neither expanded interpretation is securely established by this source alone.
The quoted verse can stand as a quotation after a modern introduction.
The death precedes the empress's lament. The highly specific reference is a plausible contextual paraphrase.
The Jin attack motivates Wang Shu's gathering of scattered troops for relief.
Two people receive different governorships. Untranslated or corrupted names change the assignments.
